noveltyJustification: Six findings are new evidence on discovery depth, roots, frontmatter and limits; two extend the repo's Pi/Hermes mirror precedent into a dsh-specific decision.
answeredQuestions: What skill format does the harness load, and should this repo use generated copies or symlinks?
ruledOut: Editing 57 canonical SKILL.md files to add optional keys

label: Skill discovery is exactly one level deep: a skill is <root>/<name>/SKILL.md or <root>/<name>.md, and nested **/SKILL.md files are deliberately not discovered.
.skilled/skills holds 16 top-level hub directories but 57 SKILL.md files, so a whole-tree symlink at .dsh/skills would surface only the 16 hubs and hide 41 nested mode packets.

Skill roots are ranked: project .dsh/skills 100, project .agents/skills 200, customSkillDirs 300, $DSH_HOME/skills 400, $DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills 500, bundled 600; the project root is the nearest ancestor containing .git, else the cwd.

Frontmatter requires a kebab-case name and a description; optional keys are whenToUse, metadata, disable-model-invocation and user-invocable, and the parser ignores this repo's extra trigger_phrases, importance_tier, contextType, allowed-tools and version fields rather than rejecting them.

There is no content scanner, quarantine or skill size limit; invalid files are skipped with a warning, failed roots are omitted and retried, bodies load on demand, and catalog descriptions are capped at 500 characters by default.
Symlinked skill directories are explicitly supported and keep their resolved instruction path as the resource base, so a per-skill symlink farm preserves each packet's references, scripts and assets.
Duplicate skill names resolve by layer, then root rank, then provider order, with the loser hidden and logged, so project-root .dsh/skills at rank 100 shadows same-named user skills.

The smallest correct move is a generated per-skill symlink farm of all 57 canonical skill directories, not a whole-tree symlink and not a markdown-only copy tree, because dsh has no scanner and Pi's whole-directory link would lose 41 skills here.

reason: One-level discovery would expose only the 16 hub skills and hide 41 nested mode packets.
Copies would lose references, assets and scripts unless every body carried a canonical pointer, and dsh has no scanner reason to avoid links.
